name: Scaber Stalk
summary: In Darkshore, Barithras Moonshade seeks Scaber Stalks from a hidden cavern behind Cliffspring Falls.

sections.title: A Rare Fungal Specimen
sections.body: Scaber Stalks grow in a subterranean cave behind Cliffspring Falls, among the northeastern mountains of Darkshore. The pale mushrooms thrive in the damp, secluded cave network, far from ordinary forest growth. Their remote, hazardous home makes them rare to gather, and Barithras Moonshade in Auberdine commissions scouts to brave its darkness.

sections.title: A Shadow in the Falls
sections.body: The Grove of the Ancients warned local night elves away from gathering Scaber Stalks. Its venerable tree-spirits sensed a dark, growing evil establishing itself within the Cliffspring Falls cave. Alchemists value the stalks alongside rare Death Caps for experimental draughts, but anyone seeking them may meet the malice taking root beneath the mountains.

faq.answer: Scaber Stalks grow in the damp cave behind Cliffspring Falls, along Darkshore's northeastern mountains.
Barithras Moonshade in Auberdine seeks Scaber Stalks and a Death Cap to brew a specialized potion.

faq.q: Why didn't Barithras Moonshade collect the stalks himself?
faq.answer: The Grove of the Ancients warned Barithras away from the cave after its spirits sensed a dangerous new evil taking refuge behind the waterfall.

faq.q: What else grows alongside Scaber Stalks?
faq.answer: The cavern also shelters the lethal Death Cap mushroom, another rare specimen Barithras needs for his alchemical research.

angles.text: These subterranean stalks are not a standard traded herb, but they offer insight into how unusual cavern climates and encroaching shadows affect local fungi.
As a night elf, you heed the Grove of the Ancients' warnings and approach these cave mushrooms with care; a corrupting presence festers near Cliffspring Falls.
